pages.text: Full Akaishi gear: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, sword, pickaxe, shovel, axe.$(br)Forged from Akaishi Ingots, strengthenable with upgrade templates.
The Equipment Forger spends energy and upgrade points to add stats (attack speed/damage, efficiency, health, armor, toughness) and unlock lifesteal, knockback, haste and more.
The Upgrade Station adds more slots to gear, 20M energy each.
